title: A display sample and its price card
passage:
HARBOR LAMP COMPANY | Showroom handover

The lamp on the centre table is a working sample. The sticker underneath gives its repair record number; it is not the product number customers should use to order. The current version is on the wall shelf beside the table. Ask the visitor to use the code on the shelf card when placing an order.

Visitors may switch on the working sample to compare its two light settings. Don't use the sample to demonstrate the timer, since that feature isn't fitted to it. If someone wants to see how the timer works, offer the short video on the counter tablet. It shows the current version with the same timer that customers will receive.

The price card beside the sample is accurate for a lamp sold on its own. Installation is offered separately. If you put a written estimate in a customer's envelope, itemize installation only if the customer asked for it; never add it simply because the lamp will be delivered.
passageZh:
港灣燈具公司｜展示間交接須知

中央桌上的燈是可正常操作的樣品。燈底的貼紙標示維修紀錄編號，不是顧客訂購時應使用的產品編號。現行款放在桌旁的牆架上。請告訴訪客，訂購時要使用架上卡片的代碼。

訪客可以打開這盞展示樣品，比較兩種亮度設定。樣品沒有裝計時器，不要用它示範定時功能。如果有人想了解計時器怎麼用，可以請他看櫃檯平板上的短片。影片示範的是現行款，所用計時器與顧客收到的相同。

樣品旁的價卡正確標示單買一盞燈的價格。安裝是另外提供的服務。如果要在顧客的信封內附上書面估價，只有顧客主動詢問安裝時才將安裝費列為一項；不要只因燈具需要配送，就把安裝費加進去。
